name: Indy 500
unique: The largest single day sporting event in the world: 300,000 people, a brick start finish line, and a century of tradition from the milk bottle to the snake pit.
buzz: Even nonfans are converted by the spectacle; bring ear protection and arrive early. The infield is a party, the stands are the racing.

name: Holiday World
unique: The world's first theme park, still family owned, with free unlimited soda, free sunscreen and two of the best water coasters on earth.
buzz: Parents rave about the free perks and clean park; the Thanksgiving themed rides are charming. It is a genuine value.

name: The Children's Museum of Indianapolis
unique: The largest children's museum in the world, with a dinosaur hall, a carousel, a space station and a working water clock.
buzz: Overwhelming in a good way, with enough for a full day. The dinosaur exhibit is the star.

name: Turkey Run State Park
unique: Deep sandstone canyons with ladders, a suspension bridge and hemlock gullies, plus a Sugar Creek canoe run that is the best float in the state.
buzz: Hoosiers call it their favorite park; Trail 3 is the classic. Canoe rentals fill up on summer weekends.

name: Brown County State Park
unique: The largest state park in Indiana, with ridge trails, a fire tower, a lodge and some of the best fall color in the Midwest.
buzz: The fire tower view is the payoff and the trails are rolling. October is packed.

name: Conner Prairie
unique: A living history park with an 1836 village, a Lenape camp, a working farm and a balloon ride.
buzz: The interpreters are good and kids can try chores and crafts. Allow half a day.

name: Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum
unique: A museum of the 500 with winning cars, trophies and the bricks, plus a track tour on the speedway.
buzz: The winning cars and the track tour are the reasons. Book the tour with the museum.

name: Newfields
unique: An art museum and 152 acre campus with gardens, a lake, a greenhouse and a sculpture park.
buzz: The gardens and the art are both strong, and the campus is a good walk. Free on some days.

name: Indiana Dunes
unique: A national park of 15 miles of Lake Michigan beach, 200-foot dunes and black oak savanna, an hour from Chicago.
buzz: The 3 Dune Challenge is a real workout with a great view; the beach is the cleanest near Chicago. Summer parking fills by 9am.

name: Parke County Covered Bridge Festival
unique: A county with 31 covered bridges and a festival that fills them with craft fairs, food and traffic.
buzz: Pick a few bridges and drive the back roads, and go early to beat the crowds. The festival is the busiest week.

name: University of Notre Dame
unique: A campus with the Golden Dome, the basilica, the grotto and the football stadium, all walkable around two lakes.
buzz: The basilica and the grotto are the quiet highlights, and game weekends are a scene. Free to walk.

name: French Lick Springs
unique: A historic mineral spring resort with a grand hotel, a casino, a spa and the Pluto mineral water that made it famous.
buzz: The hotel is a step back in time and the grounds are pretty. Worth a walk even if you are not staying.

name: Indiana State Fair
unique: A big state fair with livestock shows, a midway, tractor pulls, fried food and the dairy bar.
buzz: The dairy bar and the livestock barns are the local picks. Go on a weekday.

name: Shipshewana Auction and Flea Market
unique: An Amish run livestock auction and a thousand vendor flea market where you can buy a horse, a pie and a hand forged tool in the same morning.
buzz: The auction is the real show; get there at 8am for the horses. The flea market is enormous and the food is excellent.

name: Fair Oaks Farms
unique: A working dairy and pig farm with a bus tour through the barns, a cheese operation, a restaurant and a giant jumping pillow, all in the middle of Indiana corn.
buzz: The bus tour is better than expected and the cheese is excellent; it is a long drive from anywhere, which keeps it uncrowded.
